title: Best Custom GPTs for Job Search, Résumés and Applications in 2026
summary: The GPT Store is full of job search GPTs. Tsenta ranks the 2026 best for résumé tailoring, interview prep and tracking, and explains which can apply.
body_markdown:
**The best custom GPTs in the GPT Store for job search in 2026 are Job Finder and Job Search Assistant for finding roles, Jobright’s Resume GPT and Resume.co’s GPT for résumé tailoring, Quacle for cover letters, and InterviewMe.GPT and Mock Interview candidate & interviewer coach for interview prep.** None of them submits applications, and none is built just to track them. Use them for drafts and practice, because OpenAI retires custom GPTs on December 11, 2026, three weeks after this guide went up.


To have applications submitted from inside ChatGPT, connect an app for a service that submits them, not a GPT. Tsenta’s MCP server is one: it connects to ChatGPT as a custom plugin, finds roles ranked against your profile and starts applications that Tsenta submits on supported company career sites, on ChatGPT Business, Enterprise and Edu, the plans OpenAI lists with full MCP support. For apps rather than GPTs, see our[ranking of ChatGPT apps for job search](https://tsenta.com/blog/best-chatgpt-apps-job-search-2026) .


## Custom GPTs retire on December 11, 2026


[OpenAI’s retirement FAQ](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001519-custom-gpt-retirement-and-migration-faq) schedules custom GPTs to retire on **December 11, 2026** . FedRAMP workspaces and Enterprise workspaces with a qualifying, approved deferral get a later date. On the retirement date, custom GPTs and their GPT pages become inaccessible, including every GPT linked in this guide. Your past conversations with a GPT stay in your chat history.


On a personal account, you also cannot build a new one.[OpenAI’s GPT help article](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8554407-gpts-in-chatgpt) says new GPT creation and publishing are not available on personal accounts, including Free, Go, Plus and Pro. Affected Enterprise workspaces stopped creating GPTs on October 26, 2026, while FedRAMP workspaces can still create them.


What replaces them depends on who you are:


- **A GPT’s creator migrates it to a plugin.** Under **My GPTs** , the creator selects **Migrate to plugin** . Instructions become a skill and knowledge files become reference files, but custom actions do not transfer.
- **You keep your own instructions in a project.** OpenAI suggests a project if you used a GPT for ongoing work: add your instructions in **Project settings** , upload your résumé and chat inside it.[ChatGPT’s pricing page](https://chatgpt.com/pricing/) lists projects on Free, Go, Plus and Pro.
- **Apps handle real data and actions.** OpenAI now calls them plugins and lists them in the Plugin directory. A service that is not listed there, such as Tsenta, connects as a custom MCP server.


If you use someone else’s GPT, you cannot migrate it yourself. Check the notice on the GPT and any guidance from its creator about a replacement. OpenAI says access to a public GPT does not guarantee access to its replacement plugin.


## How we chose these GPTs


Published November 20, 2026. Tsenta publishes this guide and sells one of the services in it. No GPT here is ours. GPT pages sent us to a sign-in screen when we were logged out, so on November 20, 2026 we confirmed each GPT’s name, builder and description from its indexed GPT page and, where it has one, its listing in the[AIPRM GPT directory](https://app.aiprm.com/gpts) , which copies the GPT’s own listing. We did not test the GPTs in signed-in sessions, so this ranking rests on their listings, not their output.


We rank GPTs whose listing says what you give it and what you get back, and we name the builder wherever the listing shows one. We dropped the “Resume Tailoring to Roles” GPT that other lists cite, because we could not confirm its name, builder or description, and one GPT whose listing now describes an unrelated product. We found no custom GPT published by Teal or Jobscan, and a GPT named “Teal AI” has no stated link to Teal.

## Best custom GPTs for job search


Start with ChatGPT itself. Since[June 1, 2026](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes) , ChatGPT surfaces live listings from sources like Indeed, Upwork and Appcast for US users on Free, Go, Plus and Pro, with links to apply on the source site. None of the GPTs below names a job database, so check every link against the employer’s own posting.


### 1. Job Finder, by Elise Bishop


[Job Finder](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-RCrF7tM9y-job-finder) asks for your job title, location, industry and employment type, then returns links to matching listings, plus tips on résumés and interviews. Where it wins: the clearest inputs of the job-search GPTs we found. A second Job Finder, by careerpals.co, exists, so use this link.


### 2. Job Search Assistant, by MR L HARDING


[Job Search Assistant](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-685aa135e5848191afc1c230a1c2110a-job-search-assistant) has a one-line pitch: “Upload Your CV to search company careers sites directly.” Where it wins: it points at employers’ own career sites rather than job boards, though it does not say which.


### 3. Job Hunt Helper, by Leah Davis


[Job Hunt Helper](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-wNXYHiyTc-job-hunt-helper) says it tracks recent, relevant postings and helps with LinkedIn, résumés and networking. It describes no saved list or alerts.


## Best custom GPTs for résumé tailoring


ChatGPT now tailors without a GPT: since June 1, 2026 you can upload or create a résumé, tailor it to a role and download it formatted, in English on the web on every plan. A GPT adds its builder’s instructions, such as a keyword focus.


### 1. Resume, by jobright.ai


[Jobright’s Resume GPT](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-MrgKnTZbc-resume) says it combines “the expertise of top resume writers” with AI to diagnose your résumé and tailor it for a specific job. Its listing notes that ChatGPT does not fully support résumé downloads and sends you to Jobright’s site for that.[FeaturedGPTs’ résumé list](https://featuredgpts.com/categories/resume-writing/) shows it with 24.3K+ ratings averaging 4.4 out of 5 and 500K+ conversations in an undated snapshot, the most on that list.


Where it wins: the most ratings and conversations on FeaturedGPTs’ résumé list. Jobright also publishes a[Resume Builder plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/resume-builder) that turns an uploaded PDF or DOCX into a downloadable PDF and does not depend on custom GPTs. See our[Tsenta vs Jobright comparison](https://tsenta.com/blog/tsenta-vs-jobright) .


### 2. Resume.co’s résumé GPT


Resume.co’s[Resume GPT](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-iPOQIlHpk) calls itself a free résumé builder that tailors your résumé to any job, highlights key skills, quantifies achievements and boosts ATS compatibility. FeaturedGPTs, which lists it as Resume writer, shows 4 out of 5 from 63 ratings. Where it wins: building a résumé from scratch and tailoring it in one conversation.


### 3. Resume - ATS Optimizer, by Allison Braund-Harris


[Resume - ATS Optimizer](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-m1dJitKAl-resume-ats-optimizer) fits your résumé to a job description or title and says it makes sure you have the right keywords for applicant tracking systems. Ask for the missing keywords first, then add only the ones your experience supports.


### 4. Fine Tune Your Resume (CV) to A Job Description, by David Pollard


[This GPT](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-HO07DhHgm-fine-tune-your-resume-cv-to-a-job-description) takes your résumé and a link to a job description and tunes one to the other. If it cannot open the link, paste the description text.


Compare any rewrite with your original line by line, because it can add skills or numbers you never gave it. Tsenta makes that trade-off a setting: Honest mode rewords your existing experience, and Aggressive mode rewrites more freely and may stretch claims, so review every claim before you send.


## Best custom GPTs for cover letters


ChatGPT’s own[cover letter guide](https://chatgpt.com/learn/cover-letter/) covers the basics: upload your résumé and the job description, then turn the letter into a template with placeholders. These GPTs add a house style.


### 1. Quacle - the Cover Letter Assistant, by Feridoon Malekzadeh


[Quacle](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-HgRuX0UPk-quacle-the-cover-letter-assistant) writes “human-sounding, unique, and compelling cover letters” from the job description, your résumé and a few sentences on why you want the job. Where it wins: that last input, which a letter built only from your résumé lacks.


### 2. Cover Letter Maker, by Christopher Jettoo


[Cover Letter Maker](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-WHklZcw9f-cover-letter-maker) promises letters that “sound genuinely human.” Its listing says less about inputs, so paste the job description and your résumé yourself.


### 3. Cover Letter Generator, by Adam Blackman


[Cover Letter Generator](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-xlMau8HzY-cover-letter-generator) writes letters from the company, the role and your résumé. At least four other GPTs share the name, so check the builder line.


Tsenta drafts a cover letter for each application when the employer’s form takes one, on every plan.


## Best custom GPTs for interview prep


Interview practice suits a GPT, because it needs only the job description, your résumé and your answers.


### 1. InterviewMe.GPT - Mock Job Interview Coach


[InterviewMe.GPT](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-VKDXfcuAB-interviewme-gpt-mock-job-interview-coach) asks for PDFs of the job description, your résumé and, optionally, your LinkedIn profile, then runs a mock interview for that position and gives feedback. Its builder is Marcos Nunes-Ueno. Where it wins: practice tied to one real job.


### 2. Mock Interview candidate & interviewer coach, by Cody L Horton


[This GPT](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-lVfOhhWJB-mock-interview-candidate-interviewer-coach) lets you practice as the candidate or the interviewer, with feedback on questions and answers.


### 3. Interview Coach, by Lazar Jovanovic


[Interview Coach](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-25uJtXZva-interview-coach) is “a supportive guide for job interview practice across various industries,” suited to general practice before a specific interview. Several GPTs share the name, so use the link.


Tsenta also has Interview prep, in Beta, on the Interview tab of its web dashboard. It runs AI mock interviews built from an interview’s company, role and round, your résumé and the job description when Tsenta has one.


## Best custom GPTs for application tracking


We found no custom GPT built only to track applications, and none of these listings describes a saved tracker. These two come closest.


### 1. JobCatcher Application Wizard, by Gerd Graumann


[JobCatcher Application Wizard](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-ORVUiAN3W-jobcatcher-application-wizard) starts when you type “start job application”, then offers a skill assessment, a cover letter, follow-ups and mock interviews for that job. To follow up, you reopen that job’s conversation and type “cmd”, so your chat history becomes the tracker. The conversations stay readable after retirement, but the GPT does not.


### 2. Job Application Automated Pipeline, by Darian Zarir Irani


[Job Application Automated Pipeline](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-XsKCdWbsC-job-application-automated-pipeline) generates ATS-friendly résumés, tailored cover letters and referral message templates for LinkedIn or email. Despite the name, its listing describes no tracking or submission.


For a tracker that keeps working after December 11:


- **OpenAI’s own use case.**[Track job applications](https://learn.chatgpt.com/use-cases/track-job-applications) builds one row per role with fit, gaps, status, deadline and next action, using ChatGPT’s Spreadsheets skill. OpenAI files it as a Codex use case for the ChatGPT desktop app.
- **Dreamwork.** Its[plugin listing](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ac46d7cde448191913c0427e0ebf05a) says you can save jobs, prepare tailored résumés and cover letters and track your applications in ChatGPT.
- **Tsenta.** On ChatGPT plans with full MCP, Tsenta’s MCP server lets ChatGPT read the status of every application Tsenta starts and manage your tracker: add roles you applied to elsewhere, import a spreadsheet and move each one through Applied, Interviewing, Offer, Rejected or Ghosted. Changing a stage never submits or withdraws an application.


Our[guide to tracking applications with AI assistants](https://tsenta.com/blog/track-job-applications-ai-assistants-2026) compares these across assistants.


## Can a custom GPT auto apply to jobs?


No, not by itself. OpenAI documents no job application feature for GPTs.[OpenAI says](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8554407-gpts-in-chatgpt) a GPT reaches outside services through **actions** , which call external APIs its builder defines, or **apps** , but not both at once. So a GPT could submit an application only if its builder wired an action to a service that submits them, and[OpenAI’s actions docs](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/actions/production) say ChatGPT, by default, asks you to confirm any action that does more than fetch data.


The GPTs named for auto-apply do not say how they would submit anything:


- [Job Auto Apply Machine (J.A.A.M)](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-f8FxXEGa8-job-auto-apply-machine-j-a-a-m) describes itself only as “I assist with job applications and cover letters.”
- [JobGPT 2.0: An AI-driven Application Assistant](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-I3huaRCc2-jobgpt-2-0-an-ai-driven-application-assistant) , by Felipe Avinzano, says you can apply to multiple jobs “with just a few clicks” without saying how. It is not 6figr’s JobGPT, which is an MCP server.


This route is closing too: custom actions do not transfer to a plugin, and personal accounts cannot build a new GPT. ChatGPT Work’s[cloud browser](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001280-using-cloud-browser-in-chatgpt) can fill in forms on supported websites on paid plans except Free and Go, but OpenAI does not describe it as a job application feature.


What does apply from ChatGPT is a plugin or custom MCP server connected to a service that submits applications. Dreamwork is in the Plugin directory, and[Dreamwork says](https://www.dreamworkhq.com/apply-to-jobs-with-claude-or-chatgpt) its app sends each application after you confirm it in the chat, on Dreamwork’s paid plans, and that ChatGPT’s plan limit for custom servers does not cover it. We did not test it. As custom MCP servers, which need a ChatGPT plan with full MCP, Tsenta,[LoopCV](https://www.loopcv.pro/apply-with-chatgpt/) ,[JobGPT](https://github.com/6figr-com/jobgpt-mcp-server) and[Simplify](https://help.simplify.jobs/articles/8107058-use-simplify-in-claude-chatgpt-and-codex-mcp) each document one. Simplify’s needs an active Simplify+ subscription, and Simplify says its assistant never submits without asking you first. See our[MCP server ranking](https://tsenta.com/blog/best-mcp-servers-job-search-2026) and[how AI agents apply to jobs](https://tsenta.com/blog/how-ai-agents-apply-to-jobs-2026) .


## How Tsenta adds applying and tracking inside ChatGPT


Tsenta is not a custom GPT, so the retirement does not touch it. It is an MCP server that connects your AI assistant to your Tsenta account. Added to ChatGPT as a custom MCP server, which ChatGPT turns into a plugin, it lets ChatGPT:


- **Find roles.** Tsenta watches 300,000+ company career pages and ranks roles against your profile, with filters for location, remote or hybrid, pay, experience and date posted. ChatGPT can read full job descriptions and links you paste.
- **Tailor and apply.** Ask it to apply to one role, a batch or a link. Tsenta tailors your résumé for each role in Honest or Aggressive mode, or sends it as written, drafts a cover letter when the form takes one and submits in the cloud on supported company career sites.
- **Track.** Read application status, update your tracker and read recruiter emails in your Tsenta inbox.


**Plan limits, per OpenAI.**[OpenAI’s help center](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12584461-connecting-custom-mcp-servers-in-chatgpt) lists full MCP support, which applying needs, on ChatGPT Business, Enterprise and Edu on the web. Pro gets read and fetch permissions only, and Plus, Go and Free are not listed. In a Business workspace, only admins and owners can add a custom server. If your plan cannot run write actions, connect the same server as a Claude connector or use Tsenta’s dashboard.


**Review controls.** An application request queues work; it does not mean the employer has it yet. With résumé auto-approval off, each tailored résumé waits for your approval, and form review stops before the final submit on employer systems that support pausing. Your assistant gives those approvals through Tsenta’s tools, so tell it to show you each résumé and form first. Auto Apply, which submits eligible roles within your filters without per-role approval, needs Power. On Starter and Pro you choose each role and Tsenta submits it.


**Price.** Connecting costs nothing extra. Your first 25 applications are free, once, with no card. In USD global pricing, Starter is $19 a month for 600 applications, Pro $39 for 1,500 and Power $99 for 4,500 per 30-day cycle. See[pricing](https://tsenta.com/pricing) for your market and other billing periods.


### Tsenta as a ChatGPT plugin


Complete your Tsenta profile and résumé in the dashboard first, including work authorization, plus your address and location, which your assistant cannot set. Then, on ChatGPT for the web, add` https://api.autojobs.me/api/v1/mcp` under **Plugins** as a custom MCP server with OAuth, sign in to Tsenta, approve and install the plugin.[Tsenta’s setup page](https://tsenta.com/mcp) , the[help article](https://help.tsenta.com/connect-claude-chatgpt-mcp) and our[guide to connecting an AI job search agent](https://tsenta.com/blog/connect-ai-job-search-agent-to-claude-chatgpt-2026) have each step.


Where others win: Tsenta is not in ChatGPT’s Plugin directory, so you add it yourself, while a GPT needs only a ChatGPT sign-in and is faster for a quick mock interview or a one-off cover letter.

## The same MCP server in other assistants


Tsenta publishes setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex. Other assistants that support custom remote MCP servers over Streamable HTTP with OAuth can use the same address, as a server you connect yourself, not an integration built by the assistant’s maker.


### Tsenta as a Claude connector


Add Tsenta’s server address as a custom connector under **Customize** , then **Connectors** , and sign in.[Claude’s help center](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11175166-get-started-with-custom-connectors-using-remote-mcp) lists custom connectors on Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise, with one on Free, so this is the route when your ChatGPT plan cannot apply. See[Tsenta for Claude](https://tsenta.com/connectors/claude) and our[Claude connectors ranking](https://tsenta.com/blog/best-claude-connectors-job-search-2026) .


### OpenClaw skill or MCP server?


Tsenta connects to OpenClaw as an MCP server rather than a skill.[OpenClaw’s docs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp/transports) describe saving a remote server with the streamable-http transport and OAuth, then signing in with` openclaw mcp login` , so use Tsenta’s server address there. Tsenta has no OpenClaw guide yet, so check the tools OpenClaw lists after you sign in, and see our[OpenClaw skills guide](https://tsenta.com/blog/best-openclaw-skills-job-search-2026) .

Possibly.[Grok Bot’s docs](https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/computer-and-apps) say that in the desktop app you can open **Connect apps** , choose **Add a custom connector** , pick **Remote HTTPS** with a server address and save it with **Add plugin** , or ask Grok Bot to add an MCP server by its address. Tsenta has no Grok Bot guide yet, so if you try it, use Tsenta’s server address and sign in to Tsenta if asked, and see our[Grok Bot plugins guide](https://tsenta.com/blog/best-grok-bot-plugins-job-search-2026) .

See our[Meta Muse guide](https://tsenta.com/blog/meta-muse-apply-to-jobs-2026) ,[Instinct guide](https://tsenta.com/blog/instinct-ai-connectors-job-search-2026) and[three-way comparison](https://tsenta.com/blog/meta-muse-vs-grok-bot-vs-instinct-job-search) .


## Using a job search GPT safely until it retires


- **Check the builder line.** Names repeat, so match the link and the builder before you upload anything.
- **Know where your data goes.**[OpenAI says](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8554407-gpts-in-chatgpt) a GPT that uses apps or external APIs may send parts of your input to that service, and OpenAI does not audit how those services use it. Builders cannot view your conversations. Leave out ID numbers, your date of birth and your home address.
- **Save what works.** Copy useful prompts into a ChatGPT project before December 11, 2026.


## Frequently asked questions


### What are the best custom GPTs for job search, résumés and interviews in the GPT Store?


The best custom GPTs for job search in 2026 are Job Finder and Job Search Assistant for finding roles, Jobright’s Resume GPT and Resume.co’s GPT for résumé tailoring, Quacle for cover letters, and InterviewMe.GPT and Mock Interview candidate & interviewer coach for interview prep. None of them submits applications. OpenAI retires custom GPTs on December 11, 2026, later for some workspaces, so plan to move to ChatGPT projects, plugins or apps.


### Which GPTs in the GPT Store are best for tailoring a résumé to a job application?


Jobright’s Resume GPT and Resume.co’s GPT are the best GPTs in the GPT Store for tailoring a résumé to a job application. Jobright’s GPT has the most ratings on FeaturedGPTs’ undated résumé list, and Resume.co’s GPT also builds a résumé from scratch. Resume - ATS Optimizer and Fine Tune Your Resume (CV) to A Job Description focus on matching one job description. Check every rewritten line before you send it, and expect all of them to stop working on December 11, 2026.


### What are the best GPTs for job application tracking?


No custom GPT we found is built only to track job applications. JobCatcher Application Wizard keeps one conversation per job for follow-ups, and Job Application Automated Pipeline drafts materials for each role. For a tracker in ChatGPT, OpenAI’s Track job applications use case builds one row per role with its Spreadsheets skill, and on ChatGPT Business, Enterprise and Edu, the plans OpenAI lists with full MCP support, Tsenta’s MCP server lets ChatGPT read and update a tracker that Tsenta’s own applications enter automatically.


### Can a custom GPT auto apply to jobs?


No, a custom GPT cannot auto apply to jobs on its own. OpenAI documents no job application feature for GPTs, and a GPT reaches another service only through actions or apps its builder adds, with ChatGPT asking you to confirm by default any action that does more than fetch data. GPTs named for auto-apply, such as Job Auto Apply Machine, do not say how they would submit anything. To apply from ChatGPT, use a plugin whose maker says it submits applications, such as Dreamwork, or connect a custom MCP server that submits, such as Tsenta’s, on a plan with full MCP support, which OpenAI lists on Business, Enterprise and Edu.


### What are the best ChatGPT apps for tailoring my résumé to each job?


Workopia and Tsenta are the best ChatGPT apps for tailoring your résumé to each job. Workopia tailors your résumé inline for a job you open and drafts a cover letter, and Tsenta tailors your résumé for every role it applies to, in Honest or Aggressive mode, on ChatGPT Business, Enterprise and Edu, the plans OpenAI lists with full MCP support. Upplai scores your résumé against a job description from 0 to 100, and ChatGPT can tailor and download a résumé itself, in English on the web on every plan.


### When do custom GPTs retire, and what replaces them?


OpenAI retires custom GPTs on December 11, 2026, and later only for FedRAMP workspaces and Enterprise workspaces with an approved deferral. On the retirement date GPTs and their pages become inaccessible, while your past conversations stay. Creators can migrate a GPT into a plugin, though custom actions do not transfer, and OpenAI suggests a project if you used a GPT to keep instructions and files together.


### Can I still create a custom GPT for my job search?


No, not on a personal account. OpenAI says new GPT creation and publishing are not available on Free, Go, Plus and Pro, and affected Enterprise workspaces stopped creating GPTs on October 26, 2026. Put your instructions and résumé in a ChatGPT project instead, which every individual plan includes, or create a plugin, which ChatGPT’s pricing page lists on Go, Plus and Pro.


### Is Tsenta a custom GPT?


No, Tsenta is not a custom GPT, so the retirement does not affect it. Tsenta is an MCP server that connects to your AI assistant. On ChatGPT for the web you add it under Plugins as a custom MCP server with OAuth, and applying needs full MCP support, which OpenAI lists on ChatGPT Business, Enterprise and Edu. Tsenta is not listed in ChatGPT’s Plugin directory.
